baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence كادوا / يستفزونك / الأرض / يخرجوك / لا يلبثون خلافك إلا قليلا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A nearly completed destabilization aims to move the addressee off his territorial footing and outside it, but the temporal-spatial vector reverses: those remaining behind him have only a slight stay.

activation_trace.role: The branch's approach-to-action image marks the expulsion as near culmination rather than completed fact.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the operative motion from settled footing toward displacement.
The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the concrete territorial plane from which removal is attempted.
Passage outside a locus completes the intended displacement vector.
Staying in a place makes the counter-result concern the aggressors' own tenure.
Being behind or after locates their curtailed tenure in the addressee's wake.
Smallness limits the duration or extent of that post-removal tenure.

changed_reading.before: They almost expel you from the land, after which they remain only briefly.
changed_reading.after: Their nearly successful attempt to shake you off your territorial footing contains a reversal: removing you does not secure their footing, and their own tenure behind you contracts to almost nothing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كادوا joined to خلافك and the shortness of their remaining.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alternate mapped ك ي د inventory lets the near-event carry an engineered-pressure overlay; خلاف can then be heard not only as chronology but as attempted succession, so the scheme seeks an order that replaces the expelled figure yet cannot last.

activation_trace.role: The alternate mapped branch contributes calculated intrigue as an exploratory overlay on the near-action construction.
Destabilizing lightness is the scheme's means of detaching the addressee from his settled place.
Coming after and standing in another's place supplies the attempted-succession dimension.
Fewness or smallness makes that successor order sharply curtailed.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts a short interval after an attempted expulsion.
changed_reading.after: The attempted expulsion can also be heard as a calculated bid to install a replacement order after you, one whose capacity to succeed or endure is itself slight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يستفزونك is answered by لا يلبثون ... إلا قليلا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus branches form a stability chiasm: the addressee is targeted with motion away from settled earth, while the would-be displacers inherit delay, agitation, and little fixity in the very aftermath they seek.

activation_trace.role: Shaking stability initiates the hostile motion.
Adherence and heaviness toward earth sharpen what the provocation tries to undo.
Delay and slowness make their inability to remain a failure of settled continuation.
Agitation and lack of fixity transfer instability to the aggressors' aftermath.

changed_reading.before: One party is displaced and the other stays for a short time.
changed_reading.after: The attempted transfer of instability rebounds: those who try to unsettle the addressee become the party with little fixity after him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier identical except-little construction makes قليلا in the focus echo an exceptional residue. This does not erase its temporal syntax, but lets the aggressors' remaining be heard as a scant remnant as well as a short duration.

activation_trace.role: Remaining in place preserves the focus construction's primary temporal-tenure frame.
Fewness supplies the small measure applied to their remaining.
The earlier except-few occurrence activates a remnant pattern inside the focus verse's except-little ending.

structural_cues: 17:62 and 17:76 both close their threats with إلا قليلا, while the grammatical head differs between a population and a stay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated exception formula; I infer a residue echo across it. The live alternative is that 17:76 remains exclusively adverbial and temporal.

changed_reading.before: They remain after you only for a little time.
changed_reading.after: They remain after you only slightly: primarily for little time, but with an exploratory echo of being reduced to a scant remnant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact استفزز recurrence identifies the focus استفزاز as a recognizable campaign technology: audible incitement and noisy mustering shake a person loose, then convert that loss of stability into physical expulsion.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the targeted shaking of stability.
The imperative recurrence supplies the packet's explicit prototype for provocation that moves people from settled judgment or place.
Audible voice supplies the propagating medium of the destabilization.
Shouting and gathering against a target turn isolated pressure into mobilized collective force.
Movement outside the land is the campaign's intended concrete result.

structural_cues: 17:64 expands provocation through voice, cavalry, foot forces, participation in wealth and children, and promises before 17:76 repeats the same rare verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact verb recurrence plus instruments of mobilization; I infer that the later human actors instantiate that earlier provocation pattern. A live alternative is simple lexical echo without agent-level identification.

changed_reading.before: They nearly pressure you into leaving the land.
changed_reading.after: They nearly execute a coordinated provocation campaign whose voices and mustering first dissolve stability and then seek territorial ejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of coercive authority and the counter-image of sufficient guardianship explain the almost but not completed event: the destabilizing campaign can approach its goal, yet it cannot turn pressure into durable sovereignty after the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Approach without stated completion marks the campaign's limit.
Capacity and governing authority, explicitly denied in context, define what the provocation cannot finally possess.
The one who sufficiently keeps an affair supplies the counter-force preserving the addressee through the pressure.
The aggressors' curtailed stay displays their failure to convert pressure into settled rule.

structural_cues: 17:65 directly follows the command to provoke and directly denies lasting authority over the protected servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provocation, denied authority, guardianship, and the later near-expulsion; I infer that denied authority explains both non-completion and the attackers' brief aftermath. The alternative is that 17:65 concerns only spiritual influence, not political tenure.

changed_reading.before: The expulsion happens to fall short and is followed by a short stay.
changed_reading.after: Its near-success is the visible boundary of a coercion that can agitate but cannot acquire durable authority; the short aftermath exposes that limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The land-sea sequence repeatedly removes confidence from every surface: sea distress gives way to rescue on dry land, dry land can sink, and return to sea can drown. Against that mobility, الأرض in the focus is less an absolutely secure possession than the current platform from which hostile actors try to force another transition.

activation_trace.role: Earth supplies the concrete platform targeted for removal in the focus.
Wide abundant water supplies the first unstable domain of distress.
Dry land or desert supplies the apparent rescued footing that follows the sea.
Earth's sinking cancels the assumption that the dry surface guarantees security.
Return after departure supplies the repeated cross-domain transition.
Drowning supplies the terminal risk of forced return to the water domain.
Exit from a locus converts the contextual domain shifts into the focus's threatened human displacement.

structural_cues: 17:67 moves from sea to dry land, 17:68 threatens the side of dry land, and 17:69 threatens return to sea before 17:76 names removal from the earth or land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating surfaces and repeated removal of security; I infer a spatial grammar in which expulsion is forced transfer between contingent platforms. The alternative is that الأرض names a specific homeland with no sea-land overlay.

changed_reading.before: The threat concerns loss of one secure homeland.
changed_reading.after: The threat tries to control which surface the addressee may occupy, within a context that denies any creaturely group permanent command of land, sea, departure, or return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated كادوا constructions reveal two consecutive displacement attempts. First comes pressure to move the addressee away from what was revealed and fabricate another discourse; divine تثبيت blocks even a slight lean. Then استفزاز seeks to move the still-fixed person from the land itself. Textual displacement fails and territorial displacement becomes the next tactic.

activation_trace.role: The first approach-to-action construction establishes a near-completed pressure episode parallel to the focus.
Deflection from truth supplies the first episode's intended directional movement.
Fabricated falsehood specifies the substitute discourse toward which the first pressure points.
Strengthening and fixing supplies the counter-action that prevents displacement.
Inclining and settling toward the pressurers measures the slight movement that stabilization blocks.
Smallness quantifies the blocked lean and prepares the focus ending's second small measure.
Shaking settledness translates the failed inward deflection into an outward removal tactic.
Exit from the land is the second episode's concrete substitute objective.

structural_cues: 17:73 and 17:76 share وإن كادوا plus a causative pressure against the same addressee; 17:74 places تثبيت and a slight ركون between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel near-action syntax, first a revealed-message target, then a land target, with stabilization between; I infer tactical escalation from inward or textual displacement to outward or territorial displacement. The alternative is two related pressures without a deliberate sequence.

changed_reading.before: 17:76 is an isolated political expulsion attempt.
changed_reading.after: 17:76 is the second displacement front: after stabilization blocks movement away from revelation, the pressure shifts to moving the revelation-bearer away from the land.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verse converts the focus's reversal into a recurrent messenger-pattern. A community may drive a messenger toward departure, but the order that remains after him does not gain open-ended tenure; the path is presented as resistant to alteration.

activation_trace.role: Remaining in place is the local consequence generalized by the next verse.
Smallness supplies the curtailed duration within the recurring pattern.
A running, followed path turns the local consequence into an established historical course.
Messenger and message identify the class of prior cases to which the focus event belongs.
Change from one state to another, explicitly negated, marks the pattern as non-convertible.

structural_cues: 17:77 immediately apposes the practice concerning previously sent messengers to the focus consequence and denies any transformation of that practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate historical generalization and denial of change; I infer that the short post-expulsion tenure is the content being generalized. The alternative is that the practice refers more broadly to messenger history without specifying which clause carries it.

changed_reading.before: The brief aftermath is a local prediction about one hostile group.
changed_reading.after: Their brief aftermath instantiates a recurrent, non-convertible messenger-history pattern rather than a contingent local forecast.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets خلافك carry succession as well as the ordinary after-you relation. It remains anchored in the focus branch for one thing coming after and standing in another's place, together with curtailed staying; downstream prose should retain it only as an exploratory overlay, not replace the direct temporal reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خلافك between لا يلبثون and إلا قليلا.

activation_trace.role: Coming after and taking another's place supplies a possible failed-succession image within خلافك.
Staying in the place tests whether the replacement order can consolidate.
Agitation and lack of fixity render the successor order unstable rather than merely short-lived.

changed_reading.before: They live for only a short time after the addressee leaves.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the order that tries to stand in the addressee's place fails to consolidate and remains radically unstable.

strongest_changes: 17:64 turns استفزاز into a mobilized campaign of voice and gathering rather than generic pressure.
17:73-74 make 17:76 a second displacement front after stabilization blocks deflection from revelation.
17:77 generalizes the aggressors' brief aftermath into a non-convertible messenger-history pattern.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly redistributes stability: provocation tries to shake the addressee, protection bounds its authority, land and sea lose their claim to creaturely security, and the would-be displacers inherit the short, unstable tenure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether قليلا in 17:76 should carry any remnant echo from 17:62 beyond its primary temporal force.
Whether the alternate ك ي د mapping and the succession branch of خلاف should be rendered outside exploratory commentary.
Whether the land-sea sequence materially colors الأرض here or remains a nearby but separate spatial meditation.
